_comment: Schema for ONE record in automation/threshold-evidence.jsonl (append-only, one JSON object per line). Phase A of the threshold-evolution loop. Each record is the deterministic trace of a single editorial-materiality routing decision: which signals moved, what their resolved exception_threshold was, whether the classifier judged them material, whether they were in the decision's suppressed_stale_moves[], and what the cron's routing outcome was (proceeded midweek vs. held for Friday). Read-only w.r.t. the registry — recording this NEVER changes a threshold. Validated on append via scripts/lib/schema-validate.js. Additive optional fields (e.g. downstream) are permitted.

recorded_at._comment: ISO 8601 instant the record was appended.

decision_date._comment: Date the decision pertains to. Accepts YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD to mirror the decision/observation date granularity in the repo.

dow._comment: UTC day-of-week, Sunday=0. Friday=5 is the weekly synthesis tier.

tier._comment: weekly = Friday full synthesis; exception_probe = Mon-Thu midweek probe.

signals._comment: One entry per moved signal scored by the classifier. Empty for narrative/staleness-only or KEEP decisions.

exception_threshold._comment: The resolved editorial-exception threshold at decision time (signal's own unit). null when no basis was resolvable.

threshold_basis._comment: Which rule produced exception_threshold (see materiality.js resolveThreshold).

in_suppressed_moves._comment: True if this signal id appeared in the decision's suppressed_stale_moves[] (a move held for Friday) — raw material for missed-signal detection.

proceeded._comment: Did the cron proceed with a midweek exception (true) or hold for Friday (false)?

exit_code._comment: The --classify-materiality exit code: 0 material/proceed, 3 hold, 2 cannot-classify.

downstream._comment: Filled later (when known) with the eventual gate action + panel confidence for an exception that proceeded. null until then. Kept permissive (additive) on purpose.
